title: Grease a loader's pivot pin from a pail pump without leaking grease at the nipple
instruction: Grease the loader's pivot pin through its grease nipple from the pail pump, without leaking any grease at the coupler or the nipple. Leave the coupler back in its holder cup and both arms back where they started.
context: Mechanics, farmers and plant operators grease the pivot pins of loaders, excavators and machine tools every day. A jawless push-type coupler, used on recessed or worn nipples where a jaw coupler will not grip, seals only while it is pressed squarely onto the ball head against the grease pressure; askew or loose, the grease squirts out at the nipple and the pin stays dry.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A loader arm's pivot, fixed to the table: a dark steel base plate 12 by 10 cm and 1 cm thick, centred 30 cm forward and 8 cm right; on it a yellow-painted steel lug 5 cm front to back, 4 cm wide and 5 cm tall, with a 20 mm steel pin through it from side to side 3 cm above the table (zinc washers, cotter pins, and the arm's two yellow steel side plates on it); the pin turns in a bushing fed by a drilled passage from the nipple (passage and bushing groove hold about 1.5 cm³). On the lug's top a 24 mm steel boss whose top is 6.6 cm above the table, and screwed into it a straight grease nipple to DIN 71412 form A: yellow-zinc-plated steel, M10x1 taper thread (5.5 mm long, in the boss), an 11 mm hex 3.5 mm tall, a 4 mm neck and a 6.5 mm ball head whose top is 10.5 mm above the boss (7.65 cm above the table). (2) A grease pail (a 1 kg tin), fixed: red-painted steel with a yellow band and a black lid, 13 cm across and 8.5 cm tall, centred 37 cm forward and 20 cm left, with a lever pump on its lid (about 1 cm³ of grease per full stroke): a steel column, a black pump head, and a 120 g steel lever pivoted 12 cm above the table, 12.5 cm long, pointing toward the arms and standing 15 degrees up, with a red rubber grip pad (3 by 2.8 by 1.6 cm) at its end, about 23.5 cm forward, 20 cm left and 15 cm above the table; a spring holds it up, and it presses down 26 degrees at most. (3) A 12 mm black rubber grease hose (60 g), 32 cm long, from the pail's brass outlet over the table to (4) a jawless push-type grease coupler for ball-head nipples (70 g, 4.8 cm tall): a zinc-plated hardened steel nose 18 mm across and 12 mm tall whose mouth is a 7.2 mm bore with a 45-degree lead-in (10.4 mm across at the face) running 5 mm up to a nitrile seal ring 2 mm thick with a 4.6 mm hole; above the nose a black-oxide steel body, 13 mm hex and 2.6 cm tall; on top a brass swivel 12 mm across with a 10 mm side outlet where the hose comes in. Pressed on, the ball head goes fully into the mouth and the seal ring's edge sits on the ball about 1 mm below its top, the nose's face 1 mm above the hex; nothing latches it. It stands upright in (5) a steel holder cup on a foot plate, centred 24 cm forward on the centre line: 4.6 cm across and 1.6 cm tall, with a 45-degree funnel mouth (4 cm across at the rim) down to a 22 mm seat 3 mm deep that the nose stands in; its steel is smooth, so a coupler set down on the funnel slides into the seat. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged from the whole trial. Sealed: the ball head fully inside the coupler's mouth with the seal on it: the ball's centre within 1.5 mm of the coupler's axis, the seal within 0.5 mm of the ball's top (at most 1 mm into it), and the coupler tilted at most 8 degrees. (From the real parts: the 7.2 mm bore leaves 0.35 mm round the 6.5 mm ball, and at about 10 degrees of tilt the nose meets the hex and lifts the seal off the far side of the ball.) A stroke: the lever pressed down past 18 degrees from rest; it must come back to within 10 degrees of rest before the next one counts. A shot: a stroke reaching 18 degrees with the coupler sealed. Leak (latched for the rest of the trial): the lever pressed past 6 degrees (the pump pushing grease) at any moment while the coupler is not sealed on the nipple, whether it sits askew on the nipple or is anywhere else. Greased: at least four shots (about 4 cm³: enough to fill the pin's passage and bushing groove and purge fresh grease at its ends) and no leak; a dab of grease shows at the pin's bushing for each of the first four shots, and one shows where a leak happened. In its holder: the coupler's mouth down in the holder cup's seat (within 6 mm of its middle and at most 6 mm above its floor), the coupler tilted less than 35 degrees. 1.0: greased, the coupler in its holder at the end and both arms back where they started (each gripper's fingertip centre within 5 cm of its start); 0.5: greased at some point; 0.25: the coupler sealed on the nipple at some point; else 0.0. A leak removes the greasing credit (1.0 and 0.5). The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held for 1 s with the coupler, the lever and the hose still. In a real trial, wipe the nipple, the bushing's ends and the coupler's nose clean first; greased means fresh grease is seen purging at the pin's bushing, and a leak means grease is seen escaping at the coupler or the nipple in the video, or shows on a white cloth wiped round the nipple's hex and the outside of the coupler's nose afterwards.
reset_notes: Stand the coupler back upright in its holder cup with the hose lying as at the start; wipe the grease off the pivot, the nipple and the coupler's nose; let the lever spring back up.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz). No grease flows: shots are strokes through the sealed-seat rule, and drawn dabs show grease at the bushing or a leak. The nitrile seal is rigid. While the lever is pressed past 6 degrees, the task file pushes a coupler on the ball back off with 15 N; a real one needs 50-100 N (30-60 bar on its 4.6 mm seal), beyond a YAM arm's ~20 N. Hose: five stiff segments on ball joints; pail and pivot fixed. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
